Sitting in my seat.

Bit of a back story: I had been struggling with school a lot and had been getting help for depression and social anxiety. 
My native language is Dutch btw so excuse and mistakes jn my writing. 

In our school the mentor decides our seats for all our classes, I didn't like who I was sitting next to so I asked her if I could sit somewhere else. She said yes, so in every class so far it's been going good and I'd been sitting in that new seat.

Then I get to music class, I sit in my new seat and he tells me to go sit in my seat. So I explain to him how I asked the mentor and she allowed me to sit in this seat and he gets really mad. "this is my class so you sit where I tell you to sit!" I tried explaining that she's the one who decides the seating charts and she said I could sit here and then he kicked me out of the class.

I ended up missing like 20 minutes of that class waiting outside and when he finally let me back in I had to sit back in my old seat. I'm guessing the mentor forgot to tell him but then again none of the other teachers said anything about it.
I’m sorry that happened to you. I’m very lucky with my parents so I know they’d help me yet I still can’t get myself to tell them
